content:
Hi everyone, I am Janav, a 3rd-year undergraduate Mathematics student relatively new to both Lean and Zulip. I became interested in Lean last year when I attended a Lean for the Curious Mathematician workshop, and I have since gone through most of Mathematics in Lean to get a grasp of the fundamentals.
I am interested in the area of Probability Theory and have currently been trying to formalise the book "A Second Course in Probability" by Sheldon Ross to see where that takes me.
My next semester at university involves doing an honours project, for which I am looking to contribute to Mathlib. I would be very grateful if someone could give some advice or point me towards an entry point to find formalisation projects or topics that would be useful to Mathlib. My current reference includes the "Missing theorems from undergraduate Mathematics" page, but I have no idea how easy or difficult any of these could be for me to do, nor if anyone is already working on them.
I would really appreciate anyone's input and would be happy to answer any follow-up questions.
